dcterms:description: A focused domain-specific subset of PubMed Central (PMC) documents containing about 21 million tokens, specifically selected for having a Medical Subject Heading (Mesh) term 'cancer'. This dataset was used for training ELMo embeddings.

dcterms:description: The dataset for a shared task on biomedical entity detection, containing 2000 GENIA abstracts for training and 404 abstracts for testing, annotated for protein, DNA, RNA, cell line, and cell type entity classes.
